name: Gregory Rourke
body: I dont have words right now, sending love and light to all. Pauly Danger/Paul Bedrosian, he was a brother to me,  loved him deeply. Very Thankful for every min spent. A Reggae soldier of the highest order. The Parlour Providence bedrock & Foundation Mondays at The Parlour original. Jah guide my friend the good die to young. Pauly was about FAMILY 1ST. MUSIC, LOVE AND LIGHT. A proud Papa, an amazing DJ. And a pillar or support for me over the years. Blessings and love to his family, our community and all whom he has touched.
